Overview
========

This documentation provides a comprehensive guide to the backend implementation of the TrasHandler API, detailing its key components, including endpoints, signals, custom authentication backends, websockets and middleware. The primary focus is on ensuring that developers and contributors can understand the functionality, purpose, and usage of each component within the project.


Purpose:
The purpose of this documentation is to serve as a reference for developers working on the TrasHandler API. By providing clear and detailed explanations of the code components, this documentation aims to:

 - Facilitate easier maintenance and extension of the existing codebase.
 - Enhance understanding of the project's architecture and implementation details.
 - Assist new developers in getting up to speed with the project more efficiently.
